---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
leaders <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_season = min(yearID),
    last_season = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(career_home_runs, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  left_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameGiven, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    player = str_c(nameGiven, nameLast, sep = " "),
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_season >= 1994 & first_season <= 2009,
      "Overlapped",
      "Did not overlap"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  select(player, career_home_runs, steroid_era)

ggplot(
  leaders,
  aes(
    x = career_home_runs,
    y = fct_reorder(player, career_home_runs),
    fill = steroid_era
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Steroid era (1994-2009)",
    values = c("Did not overlap" = "#3B82F6", "Overlapped" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Career Home Run Leaders",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database; era overlap defined as 1994-2009."
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
